findings.correction: Remove the unquoted blank line so the Jin Family’s Spear, Manoeuvre, and Cultivation Technique notices remain inside one continuous System blockquote.
findings.current:

findings.defect: A blank unquoted line breaks one sequence of consecutive skill notices into separate Markdown blockquotes.
findings.rationale: The binding format requires consecutive System notices with no intervening prose to remain in the same blockquote window.

findings.correction: Reconcile the stated room count with the later sequence; if six is correct, replace “the last room” with wording such as “the next room.”
findings.current: There were six rooms on the first floor alone.
findings.defect: Taekyung subsequently opens three clothing rooms and then calls the next room “the last room,” accounting for only four rooms.
findings.rationale: The present spatial description creates an internal contradiction within the scene.

findings.correction: Head the blockquote with “> **System**” and place “Skill Window” as an ordinary line inside that blockquote.
findings.defect: The game panel is headed “Skill Window” instead of using the required System-window heading.
findings.rationale: Every actual game System-message panel must be framed by a blockquote headed “System.”
findings.source: Chapter 9, Jin Family’s Manoeuvre Technique information panel

findings.correction: Replace “the Young Sect Leader” with “the Lesser Family Head.”
findings.current: It would begin with Jin Taekyung’s usual conduct and end with an attack on Jin Wikyung himself, the Young Sect Leader.
findings.defect: “Young Sect Leader” replaces Jin Wikyung’s established title, “Lesser Family Head,” and incorrectly recasts the Jin Family as a sect.
findings.rationale: The established title is binding and is used consistently elsewhere in the packet and active state.
findings.source: Chapter 9, narration about the Elder Council’s planned attack

findings.correction: Replace “the sect’s public funds” with “the family’s public funds” or “the family funds,” matching surrounding terminology.
findings.current: This is the fifth time he’s embezzled the sect’s public funds.
findings.defect: “The sect’s” introduces the same organization-type drift despite the institution consistently being the Jin Family.
findings.rationale: Calling the Jin Family a sect conflicts with the established organization name and nearby references to family rules and family funds.

findings.correction: Change “four martial arts learned” to “three martial arts occupying slots” unless a fourth art is explicitly established in the reviewed chapters.
findings.current: Taekyung has four martial arts learned; the System displays ten total martial-art slots, and he finds several hundred manuals in his residence.
findings.defect: The reading copies establish three occupied martial-art slots: the Jin Family’s Cultivation, Spear, and Manoeuvre Techniques. Chapter 9 reacquires the already occupied Manoeuvre Technique rather than adding a fourth art.
findings.rationale: An incorrect durable-state count can propagate a continuity error into later chapters and directly contradicts the displayed “(3 / 10)” slot count.

findings.correction: Render the idea with a natural English equivalent, such as hunger being the best seasoning, while retaining that he finishes the poor meal because he is hungry.
findings.current: Every side dish was either too salty or too bland, but I demolished the entire meal, using my hunger as a side dish, then downed the bowl of herbal decoction in one gulp.
findings.defect: “Using my hunger as a side dish” reads as a literal Korean idiom rather than natural contemporary English.
findings.rationale: The current collocation interrupts Taekyung’s otherwise brisk conversational narration and conflicts with the rule against Korean syntax calques.

findings.correction: Recast the confusion or wordplay into a concise natural-English joke without changing the referenced founder; if the exact Korean wording is materially important, use a brief spoiler-free footnote.
findings.current: The hereditary martial art created by some fellow called the founder—or was it the ancestor bird?—was unbelievably complicated.
findings.defect: “Ancestor bird” is unintelligible in English and reads like an accidental literal rendering of wordplay rather than a functioning joke.
findings.rationale: The unexplained phrase obscures the joke and causes avoidable voice drift in an otherwise direct internal monologue.
findings.source: Chapter 9, Taekyung recalling the technique’s founder

summary: The packet is broadly coherent and preserves Taekyung’s voice, but it contains two binding System-panel formatting errors, two instances of family/sect terminology drift, one contradiction in the durable state, one room-count contradiction, and two awkward literal renderings.
